brief_description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (GA): fast, low-cost video generation and editing. Text/image to video up to 15s, video editing, first-and-last-frame interpolation, reference-guided generation and upscaling to 1080p/4K, at 360p/720p/1080p/4K from $0.02/s.
detailed_description:
# Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash API Usage Guide

## Overview

**Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash** is Google's fast, cost-effective video model for generation and editing, built for high-volume work such as product and catalog clips, virtual try-ons, ad variations and creative applications. It turns a text prompt, optionally with reference images or input videos, into video with generated audio at 360p, 720p, 1080p or 4K, in 16:9 or 9:16.

What's new in 1.2:

- **Longer clips**: text-to-video and image-to-video up to 15 seconds, and edits of source videos up to 15 seconds (up from 10).
- **Upscaling**: draft quickly at 360p or 720p, then upscale the clips you keep to 1080p or 4K.
- **Lower price**: $0.07 per second of 720p video, 30% less than Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash.
- **Consistent results**: stronger adherence to image and video references keeps characters, products and brand details consistent across shots.

All generated videos carry an invisible **SynthID** watermark and **C2PA** content credentials.

## Authentication

Include your API key in the Authorization header:

```bash
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## Submit a request

### Endpoint
```
POST https://console.gmicloud.ai/api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests
```

### Text to video (15 seconds)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.gmicloud.ai/api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-omni-1.2-flash",
    "payload": {
      "prompt": "A 3D animated bioluminescent space-fish glides over the red canyons of Mars, cinematic volumetric lighting",
      "task": "text_to_video",
      "durationSeconds": 15,
      "aspectRatio": "16:9",
      "resolution": "720p"
    }
  }'
```

### Image to video

```json
{
  "model": "gemini-omni-1.2-flash",
  "payload": {
    "prompt": "The suitcase unzips and splits open; white retro text reading 'Omnicase' pops out of the center",
    "reference_image": ["https://example.com/suitcase.png"],
    "task": "image_to_video",
    "durationSeconds": 15,
    "aspectRatio": "16:9",
    "resolution": "720p"
  }
}
```

### Edit a video

```json
{
  "model": "gemini-omni-1.2-flash",
  "payload": {
    "prompt": "Change the dog to the cat from the reference image. Remove the backpack and add a propeller hat.",
    "video": ["https://example.com/office-dog.mp4"],
    "reference_image": ["https://example.com/cat.png"],
    "task": "edit",
    "resolution": "720p"
  }
}
```

Leave `durationSeconds` and `aspectRatio` at `auto` (or omit them): the edited video follows the source clip.

### Upscale a video

```json
{
  "model": "gemini-omni-1.2-flash",
  "payload": {
    "video": ["https://example.com/draft-720p.mp4"],
    "task": "upscale",
    "resolution": "4k"
  }
}
```

`resolution` is the target and must be above the source: 360p to 720p or 1080p, 720p to 1080p or 4K, 1080p to 4K. No prompt is needed.

### Request parameters

Parameter names match our Veo video models, so a single integration works across both.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `prompt` | string | Yes, except for `upscale` | Text description of the video to generate, or of the edit to make. |
| `reference_image` | string/array | No | Up to 5 image URLs. With `image_to_video`, one image is the starting frame; two images run first-and-last-frame interpolation (first is start, second is end). |
| `video` | string/array | No | Up to 3 MP4 URLs, each up to 15 seconds. Used by `edit`, `upscale`, `extend` and `reference_to_video`. |
| `task` | enum | No | `auto` (default), `text_to_video`, `image_to_video`, `reference_to_video`, `edit`, `extend` or `upscale`. `auto` lets the model infer the task from the inputs; `reference_to_video`, `extend` and `upscale` must be requested explicitly. |
| `durationSeconds` | integer / `"auto"` | No | 3-15 seconds, or `auto` (default) to let the model decide. 15 seconds is available for text-to-video and image-to-video; interpolation and reference-to-video go up to 10. Use `auto` with a `video` input: the output follows the source clip. |
| `aspectRatio` | enum | No | `auto` (default), `16:9` or `9:16`. With a `video` input, `auto` follows the source clip. |
| `resolution` | enum | No | `360p`, `720p` (default), `1080p` or `4k`. For `upscale`, the target resolution. |

## Check status

```bash
curl "https://console.gmicloud.ai/api/v1/ie/requestqueue/apikey/requests/{request_id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

On success, `outcome.media_urls[0].url` is the generated video (MP4), with `thumbnail_image_url` alongside. To edit or upscale a result, pass that URL as `video`.

## Pricing

| Resolution | Per second of output video |
|------------|----------------------------|
| 360p | $0.02 |
| 720p | $0.07 |
| 1080p | $0.10 |
| 4K | $0.21 |

- The rate is the same with or without audio and for either aspect ratio.
- Upscaling is billed at the target resolution's rate for the length of the source video.
- Input references (text, images, video) are billed at $1.50 per 1M tokens; an image is 1,120 tokens. Text and reasoning tokens the model produces are billed at $9.00 per 1M tokens.
- The requested duration is held when you submit (15 seconds when duration is `auto`), and the charge is settled to the actual length of the video once it is generated.

## Capabilities & limits

- Duration: 3-15 seconds for text-to-video and image-to-video; up to 10 seconds for first-and-last-frame interpolation and reference-to-video.
- Input video: up to 3 videos, each up to 15 seconds. For upscale: 360p, 720p or 1080p source in 16:9 or 9:16.
- Reference images: up to 5.
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 or 9:16. Resolution: 360p, 720p, 1080p or 4K.
pricing_details: Video output per second: 360p $0.02, 720p $0.07, 1080p $0.10, 4k $0.21. Upscale is billed at the target resolution's rate for the source video's length. Input references are metered at $1.50 / 1M tokens (1120 tokens per image); text and reasoning output at $9 / 1M tokens. The requested duration (15s for auto) is held at submit and settled to the actual length of the generated video.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text description of the video to generate, or of the edit to make. Required for every task except Upscale.

parameters.name: reference_image
parameters.description: Reference image URLs. With Image to video, one image is the starting frame (up to 15s). Two images run first-and-last-frame interpolation (first is start frame, second is end frame; up to 10s). PNG/JPEG/WebP/HEIC/HEIF.

parameters.name: video
parameters.description: Input video URLs (MP4, up to 15s each). Without a task, one video is edited in place and the output follows its length. Set task to be upscale to raise its resolution, task to be extend to lengthen it, or task to be reference_to_video to use it as a style reference.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: What to do with the inputs. Auto lets the model infer it, which is what happens if you omit this. Reference to video, Extend and Upscale are only reachable by asking for them explicitly.

parameters.name: durationSeconds
parameters.description: Length of the generated video in seconds: 3-15 for text or image to video, up to 10 for interpolation and reference to video. Auto lets the model decide, and is required for editing and upscaling, where the output follows the source.

parameters.name: aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Auto lets the model/source decide.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution; higher resolutions cost more per second. For Upscale, the target, which must be above the source: 360p to 720p/1080p, 720p to 1080p/4K, 1080p to 4K.
